title: centaurea paphlagonica
intro: Centaurea paphlagonica, commonly known as Paphlagonia knapweed, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea paphlagonica include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, wounds, and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea paphlagonica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
